valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (obfinancialholdingsae) is served under two keys, OFH P/E 7.26 and OFH.CA P/E 74.89, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
